text: No, FIRMS did not record any thermal detection within the property during the period from September 26, 2026, to October 26, 2026. All sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) covered the entire period and the whole asset boundary, but no thermal anomalies were detected. However, this does not rule out the possibility of small, short, cool, or cloud-obscured fires occurring.
